text.card: A red giant 3,079 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.84 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,877 K at its surface.
